description: Erection of a rear roof extension with hip to gable conversion and two roof windows to front elevation
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ELV 01rD  Received:  25 March 2019; PLN01rA, Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  07 March 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The window formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear walls of the single storey rear infill extension or the rear roof extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
